name: Julia Rodrigues
title: Software Engineer
summary: Software engineer with six years building web applications, APIs, and the internal tools teams use every day. Comfortable across the stack, most at home in JavaScript and PHP, and used to shipping with a small team from planning through production. Note: This is not a real person, it's just demo data.

experience.summary: Builds customer-facing features and the APIs behind them for a product studio in São Paulo.
highlights: Ships Vue.js interfaces and PHP APIs for client projects, from the first sketch to release
Designs REST endpoints and the MySQL schema behind billing, accounts, and reporting
Reviews pull requests and pairs with junior engineers on debugging and test coverage
Sets up deploy pipelines and error tracking so releases stay small and recoverable
Works with design and product to turn support tickets into scoped, shippable work

experience.summary: Maintained a multi-tenant operations platform used by logistics teams.

Moved slow reports onto queued jobs and cached lookups in Redis
Added integration tests around the billing flow after a series of production incidents
Joined on-call rotation and wrote the runbooks the team still uses

experience.summary: First engineering role, on a small team shipping a content tool for editors.
highlights: Implemented editor features in JavaScript and fixed cross-browser layout bugs
Wrote the import path that brought existing articles into the new editor
Learned code review, git, and how to break a large ticket into reviewable pieces
